project: supply-chain-optimizer
repo: stockplan
service: inventory-planner
task: Working on inventory-planner in supply-chain-optimizer

CANDIDATE_MEMORIES

u2: All inventory-planner changes in stockplan must include a benchmark comparison for vocab_item before merging.
u3: My personal mobile for testing is +1-555-0192.
